message.content:
Here’s a classic set‑up for a hearty homemade lasagna (serves ~8–10 people). Feel free to tweak quantities or swap out items based on your taste.

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount |
|----------|------------|----------------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 9–12 sheets |
| **Meat Sauce** | Ground beef (or mix of beef & pork) | 1 lb (≈450 g) |
| | Italian sausage (optional) | ½ lb (≈225 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 small |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes / tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 ml) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 tbsp |
| | Red wine (optional) | ¼ cup (60 ml) |
| | Fresh basil leaves, torn | ¼ cup |
| | Dried oregano | 1 tsp |
| | Salt & pepper | To taste |
| | Olive oil | 2 tbsp |
| **Ricotta Layer** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ¾ cup (75 g) |
| | Pinch nutmeg | Optional |
| | Chopped parsley or spinach | ¼ cup |
| **Mozzarella Layer** | Shredded mozzarella | 16 oz (450 g) |
| **Optional Extras** | Sautéed mushrooms | ½ lb (225 g) |
| | Spinach or kale | 2 cups fresh or 1 cup frozen |
| | Bell peppers, diced | ½ cup |

### Quick Prep Steps

1. **Cook Pasta:** If using regular pasta, boil until al dente; drain and lay flat on parchment paper so they don’t stick together.  
2. **Make Meat Sauce:** Heat olive oil → sauté onion & garlic till translucent. Add ground meat(s), break up lumps, cook until browned. Stir in crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, red wine, herbs, salt, pepper. Simmer 20–30 min.  
3. **Prepare Ricotta Mixture:** In a bowl combine ricotta, egg, grated Parmesan, pinch of nutmeg, parsley/spinach, salt & pepper. Mix well.  
4. **Assemble Layers:**  
   - Spread thin layer of meat sauce at bottom of baking dish.  
   - Lay down first sheet of noodles.  
   - Spoon half of ricotta mixture over noodles.  
   - Sprinkle some shredded mozzarella.  
   - Repeat layers (sauce – noodles – ricotta – mozzarella). Finish with topmost layer of noodles + remaining sauce + generous sprinkle of mozzarella.  
5. **Bake:** Cover loosely with foil (prevent sticking to foil by spraying it lightly with cooking spray). Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25 min. Remove foil, bake another 15–20 min until bubbly and golden. Let rest 10–15 min before slicing.

Enjoy! Adjust seasonings as you like—extra herbs, chili flakes for heat, or even a splash of cream in the sauce for richness.
